items.briefing:
Australian small businesses are being warned that AI is enabling increasingly convincing, targeted scams — cybercriminals are using AI to personalise phishing emails and fraud attempts, making them harder to spot. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has flagged that JetBrains TeamCity servers in Australia are actively being exploited, meaning organisations using this software for software development should apply patches immediately.

A new AI testing standard from CREST is also being rolled out for cyber security firms, helping ensure AI tools are assessed more rigorously.

**Practical tip:** If your organisation uses JetBrains TeamCity, check with your IT team today to confirm it has been patched.

featured.title: University no longer default for tech careers, says Codific
featured.summary: Rising numbers of tech employers now value self-taught skills and projects over degrees, as AI and online courses reshape hiring.
